15	#pragma once
16

18	#include <string>

40	namespace zvec {
41	
42	class CombinedRecordBatchReader;
43	
44	class Segment {
45	 public:
46	  using Ptr = std::shared_ptr<Segment>;
47	
48	  static Result<Ptr> CreateAndOpen(const std::string &path,
49	                                   const CollectionSchema &schema,
50	                                   SegmentID segment_id, uint64_t min_doc_id,
51	                                   const IDMap::Ptr &id_map,
52	                                   const DeleteStore::Ptr &delete_store,
53	                                   const VersionManager::Ptr &version_manager,
54	                                   const SegmentOptions &options);
55	
56	  static Result<Ptr> Open(const std::string &path,
57	                          const CollectionSchema &schema,
58	                          const SegmentMeta &segment_meta,
59	                          const IDMap::Ptr &id_map,
60	                          const DeleteStore::Ptr &delete_store,
61	                          const VersionManager::Ptr &version_manager,
62	                          const SegmentOptions &options);
63	
64	  virtual SegmentID id() const = 0;
65	
66	  virtual SegmentMeta::Ptr meta() const = 0;
67	
68	  // Count documents visible to an optional global-doc-ID filter.
69	  virtual uint64_t doc_count(const IndexFilter::Ptr filter = nullptr) = 0;
70	
71	  // ---- Schema and index mutation -----------------------------------------
72	  virtual Status add_column(FieldSchema::Ptr column_schema,
73	                            const std::string &expression,
74	                            const AddColumnOptions &options) = 0;
75	
76	  virtual Status alter_column(const std::string &column_name,
77	                              const FieldSchema::Ptr &new_column_schema,
78	                              const AlterColumnOptions &options) = 0;
79	
80	  virtual Status drop_column(const std::string &column_name) = 0;
81	
82	  virtual Status create_all_vector_index(
83	      int concurrency, SegmentMeta::Ptr *new_segment_meta,
84	      std::unordered_map<std::string, VectorColumnIndexer::Ptr>
85	          *vector_indexers,
86	      std::unordered_map<std::string, VectorColumnIndexer::Ptr>
87	          *quant_vector_indexers) = 0;
88	
89	  virtual Status create_vector_index(
90	      const std::string &column, const IndexParams::Ptr &index_params,
91	      int concurrency, SegmentMeta::Ptr *new_segment_meta,
92	      std::unordered_map<std::string, VectorColumnIndexer::Ptr>
93	          *vector_indexers,
94	      std::unordered_map<std::string, VectorColumnIndexer::Ptr>
95	          *quant_vector_indexers) = 0;
96	
97	  virtual Status drop_vector_index(
98	      const std::string &column, SegmentMeta::Ptr *new_segment_meta,
99	      std::unordered_map<std::string, VectorColumnIndexer::Ptr>
100	          *vector_indexers) = 0;
101	
102	  virtual Status reload_vector_index(
103	      const CollectionSchema &schema, const SegmentMeta::Ptr &segment_meta,
104	      const std::unordered_map<std::string, VectorColumnIndexer::Ptr>
105	          &vector_indexers,
106	      const std::unordered_map<std::string, VectorColumnIndexer::Ptr>
107	          &quant_vector_indexers = {}) = 0;
108	
109	  virtual bool vector_index_ready(
110	      const std::string &column,
111	      const IndexParams::Ptr &index_params) const = 0;
112	
113	  virtual bool all_vector_index_ready() const = 0;
114	
115	  virtual Status create_scalar_index(
116	      const std::vector<std::string> &columns,
117	      const IndexParams::Ptr &index_params, SegmentMeta::Ptr *new_segment_meta,
118	      InvertedIndexer::Ptr *new_scalar_indexer) = 0;
119	
120	  virtual Status drop_scalar_index(
121	      const std::vector<std::string> &columns,
122	      SegmentMeta::Ptr *new_segment_meta,
123	      InvertedIndexer::Ptr *new_scalar_indexer) = 0;
124	
125	  virtual Status reload_scalar_index(
126	      const CollectionSchema &schema, const SegmentMeta::Ptr &segment_meta,
127	      const InvertedIndexer::Ptr &scalar_indexer) = 0;
128	
129	  virtual Status create_fts_index(const std::string &column,
130	                                  const IndexParams::Ptr &index_params,
131	                                  SegmentMeta::Ptr *new_segment_meta,
132	                                  FtsIndexer::Ptr *output_fts_indexer) = 0;
133	
134	  virtual Status drop_fts_index(const std::string &column,
135	                                SegmentMeta::Ptr *new_segment_meta,
136	                                FtsIndexer::Ptr *output_fts_indexer) = 0;
137	
138	  virtual Status reload_fts_index(const CollectionSchema &schema,
139	                                  const SegmentMeta::Ptr &segment_meta,
140	                                  const FtsIndexer::Ptr &new_fts_indexer) = 0;
141	
142	  // ---- Data operations ----------------------------------------------------
143	  virtual Status Insert(Doc &doc) = 0;
144	
145	  virtual Status Upsert(Doc &doc) = 0;
146	
147	  virtual Status Update(Doc &doc) = 0;
148	
149	  virtual Status Delete(const std::string &pk) = 0;
150	
151	  virtual Status Delete(uint64_t g_doc_id) = 0;
152	
153	  virtual Doc::Ptr Fetch(uint64_t g_doc_id,
154	                         const std::optional<std::vector<std::string>>
155	                             &output_fields = std::nullopt,
156	                         bool include_vector = true) = 0;
157	
158	  virtual TablePtr fetch(const std::vector<std::string> &columns,
159	                         const std::vector<int> &segment_doc_ids) const = 0;
160	
161	  virtual ExecBatchPtr fetch(const std::vector<std::string> &columns,
162	                             int segment_doc_id) const = 0;
163	
164	  // Keep Segment alive while consuming the returned reader.
165	  virtual RecordBatchReaderPtr scan(
166	      const std::vector<std::string> &columns) const = 0;
167	
168	  // ---- Index accessors ----------------------------------------------------
169	  // Keep Segment alive while using returned indexers.
170	  virtual CombinedVectorColumnIndexer::Ptr get_combined_vector_indexer(
171	      const std::string &field_name) const = 0;
172	
173	  virtual CombinedVectorColumnIndexer::Ptr get_quant_combined_vector_indexer(
174	      const std::string &field_name) const = 0;
175	
176	  virtual std::vector<VectorColumnIndexer::Ptr> get_vector_indexer(
177	      const std::string &field_name) const = 0;
178	
179	  virtual std::vector<VectorColumnIndexer::Ptr> get_quant_vector_indexer(
180	      const std::string &field_name) const = 0;
181	
182	  virtual InvertedColumnIndexer::Ptr get_scalar_indexer(
183	      const std::string &field_name) const = 0;
184	
185	  // caller hold segment shared_ptr for segment handle the indexer's lifetime
186	  virtual fts::FtsColumnIndexerPtr get_fts_indexer(
187	      const std::string &field_name) const = 0;
188	
189	  // ---- Index queries and filters -----------------------------------------
190	  virtual Result<std::vector<fts::FtsResult>> fts_search(
191	      const std::string &field_name, const fts::FtsAstNode &ast,
192	      const fts::FtsQueryParams &params) = 0;
193	
194	  // Returned filter is evaluated with segment-local row IDs. It translates the
195	  // local row ID to a global doc ID before consulting the delete store.
196	  virtual const IndexFilter::Ptr get_filter() = 0;
197	
198	  // ---- Persistence and lifecycle -----------------------------------------
199	  virtual Status flush() = 0;
200	
201	  virtual Status dump() = 0;
202	
203	  virtual Status destroy() = 0;
204	};
205	
206	}  // namespace zvec
207
